title: Paris keeps more than the look
governingQuestion: Which objects, interfaces and technical credits enter public memory?
status: evidence-backed production draft; recording, interviews and owner-final approval remain open

longform.headline: Paris keeps more than the look
longform.opening: Paris remembers fashion through incompatible systems: museum, library, platform and house.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: Palais Galliera, Paris Musées and Gallica expose different public memory systems: museum objects, open-image filters and digitized national collections.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: Discovery access and reuse permission are separate: Paris Musées marks some public-domain reproductions, while collection and library records require item-level checking.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: No complete public archive was located that preserves every Paris show’s invitations, worker credits, venue plans, source files, rights and commercial outcomes.

longform.closing: Paris Fashion Week is not one technology. It is a chain of permissions that turns recognition into circulation and circulation into memory.
